verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents an API-driven account opening flow: person and business applications, then an account application. It covers both business and personal accounts with initial funding, plus vendor KYC/KYB built into the opening process. A Developer Sandbox exists for safe testing before going live. However, the evidence never says these accounts are FDIC-insured, never shows the approval step to an active account being fully programmatic, and never confirms the account-opening flow behaves the same in sandbox as in production. Missing for 10: evidence of insured deposit status, documented programmatic transition from application approval to active account, explicit sandbox parity for the account-opening flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open a real, insured deposit account through the API — application to active account fully programmatic, with sandbox parity so the flow is tested before launch

citations.quote: To apply to open a new bank account 1. Create a Person Application 2. Create a Business Application ... 5. Create an Account Application
This guide will cover the basics of applying to open new bank accounts (both business and personal) as well as funding those accounts with an initial deposit.
Programs can seamlessly integrate their bank-approved third-party KYC/KYB vendor into the account opening process.
safely test the API without worrying about interfering with production data.
